items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: I remember Carl Hoff. You know him, don't you? Well, he's the one who pulled my coat to it. He said, "I think you're going to get the gig."

ctx.x: We went down there and made the audition, you made; we made it downstairs first... I remember Carl Hoff. You know him, don't you? Well, he's the one who pulled my coat to it. He said, "I think you're going to get the gig." [INAUDIBLE NAME] asked me to sign the contract for a hundred and a quarter; I couldn't even spell my name! Heh-heh... Yeah, it was...

But they got rid of them right quick. So then they tried to get us to stay at the Savoy... and that's when I was offered the job to go to the Cotton Club, you know, and I said, "No-no, I want to go down there." So they couldn't do that, so they said, "Well, what about your uniform?" And I said, "Well, I paid for it." Paid for it. We paid for them ourself, you know.
